lines.zh: 我在小路上蹦，尾巴一翘一翘。
lines.en: I hop along the path, tail flicking up and down.

lines.zh: 黑白羽毛在阳光下很扎眼。
lines.en: My black and white feathers stand out in the sun.

lines.zh: 我走两步就低头，看地上有没有亮的。
lines.en: Two steps, then a look down for anything bright.

lines.zh: 麦田边有一条我固定的路线。
lines.en: There is a fixed route of mine along the field.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，怕弄湿翅膀。
lines.en: I skirt the puddle; wet wings are no good.

lines.zh: 同伴在树上叫，我边走边应。
lines.en: A mate calls from the tree; I answer as I walk.

lines.zh: 我跳上矮墙，又从另一头跳下。
lines.en: I hop onto the low wall and down the other side.

lines.zh: 村里的路我熟，哪家门口有谷子都知道。
lines.en: I know the village; I know which door holds grain.

lines.zh: 我走得快，因为地上总有东西。
lines.en: I move fast; there is always something on the ground.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在身后，扫过一层灰。
lines.en: My tail drags behind, sweeping up dust.

lines.zh: 我在矿洞口停了停，里面太黑。
lines.en: I pause at the mine mouth; it is too dark inside.

lines.zh: 一有响动，我先跳上最近的枝。
lines.en: At any sound, I hop to the nearest branch.

lines.zh: 我和你保持五步，不多不少。
lines.en: I keep five steps from you, no more, no less.

lines.zh: 走过金块旁边，我脚步明显慢了。
lines.en: Passing a gold block, my pace clearly slows.

lines.zh: 我从篱笆这头走到那头，找闪光。
lines.en: I walk the fence end to end, looking for shine.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，一粒谷子也要看。
lines.en: Stop and go. Even a grain gets a look.

lines.zh: 我站在篱笆上，尾巴慢慢摆。
lines.en: I perch on the fence, tail swinging slowly.

lines.zh: 阳光照着我背上的白，很暖和。
lines.en: Sun warms the white on my back.

lines.zh: 我歪头看地，一颗石子也像宝石。
lines.en: I tilt my head; even a pebble looks like a gem.

lines.zh: 两只喜鹊对叫，像在吵嘴。
lines.en: Two magpies call at each other, squabbling.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛一根根理顺，很有耐心。
lines.en: I smooth my feathers one by one, patiently.

lines.zh: 风把我的尾巴吹歪，我又摆正。
lines.en: Wind skews my tail; I set it straight again.

lines.zh: 远处有人挖矿，声音很闷。
lines.en: Someone mines far off; the sound is muffled.

lines.zh: 我在等一个没人看着的时刻。
lines.en: I am waiting for a moment when no one watches.

lines.zh: 树上的巢有点歪，我记着要修。
lines.en: The nest is tilting; I note that it needs mending.

lines.zh: 地上有块金子，我装作没看见。
lines.en: A piece of gold lies there; I pretend not to see it.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，落下一层灰。
lines.en: I shake my wings and a layer of dust falls.

lines.zh: 太阳偏西，亮东西更显眼了。
lines.en: The sun sinks west, and shiny things show up better.

lines.zh: 我叫两声，纯粹因为高兴。
lines.en: I call twice, purely out of good spirits.

lines.zh: 鸟也是要面子的，我站得很直。
lines.en: A bird has pride; I stand very straight.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进翅膀里，理一小会毛。
lines.en: I tuck my head in a wing and preen a while.

lines.zh: 屋顶上有只猫，我盯着它不动。
lines.en: A cat on the roof. I stare without moving.

lines.zh: 你口袋一响，我就听见金粒在碰。
lines.en: Your pocket jingles and I hear the gold grains knocking.

lines.zh: 你手里有金子，我一眼就看见了。
lines.en: Gold in your hand; I spotted it at once.

lines.zh: 我歪头，一只眼看你，一只看地。
lines.en: I tilt my head, one eye on you, one on the ground.

lines.zh: 你走近，我没飞，只往旁边挪。
lines.en: You come close; I do not fly, only shift aside.

lines.zh: 我认得你，上次你掉了三颗金粒。
lines.en: I know you; last time you dropped three gold nuggets.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也看你，谁也不让。
lines.en: You look at me; I look at you; neither yields.

lines.zh: 我的黑眼睛亮得像两颗珠子。
lines.en: My black eyes shine like two beads.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我立刻退到篱笆后面。
lines.en: You raise a hand; I retreat behind the fence.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，不如金子好闻。
lines.en: You smell of iron, not as nice as gold.

lines.zh: 你的金粒在口袋里响。
lines.en: Your gold nuggets are clinking in your pocket.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就敢靠近半米。
lines.en: You crouch, and I dare come half a meter nearer.

lines.zh: 我的眼珠跟着你的指头左右转。
lines.en: My eye follows your finger left and right.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，嘴里的金子就掉了。
lines.en: You hit me once and the gold falls from my beak.

lines.zh: 我飞起来，又回头看了一眼。
lines.en: I take off, then glance back once.

lines.zh: 羽毛散了几根，飘在风里。
lines.en: A few feathers scatter on the wind.

lines.zh: 我落在树上，翅膀还在抖。
lines.en: I land in the tree, wings still trembling.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，我藏的东西不能丢。
lines.en: Pain is pain, but my hoard must not be lost.

lines.zh: 你这一下，把我今天的好运打没了。
lines.en: That blow knocked today's luck out of me.

lines.zh: 我叫得很急，同伴都抬头。
lines.en: I cry sharply and every mate looks up.

lines.zh: 我歪着飞，一边翅膀不听使唤。
lines.en: I fly crooked; one wing will not quite obey.

lines.zh: 掉出来的东西，我还会再捡回来。
lines.en: What fell out, I will gather again.

lines.zh: 再打一下，我就只剩羽毛给你。
lines.en: One more hit and only feathers remain for you.

lines.zh: 你撒下金粒，我立刻蹦过去。
lines.en: You scatter gold nuggets and I hop over at once.

lines.zh: 我叼一颗，抬头看你还撒不撒。
lines.en: I take one and look up to see if you will scatter more.

lines.zh: 金子在地上闪光，比虫子好找。
lines.en: Gold glints on the ground, easier to find than bugs.

lines.zh: 我绕着那堆锭走，先挑最小的。
lines.en: I circle the pile of ingots and pick the smallest first.

lines.zh: 你退开，我才敢低头捡。
lines.en: Only when you step back do I dare lower my head.

lines.zh: 这颗原矿不亮，我也要。
lines.en: This raw ore is dull, but I want it too.

lines.zh: 你手里那颗宝石，能给我吗。
lines.en: That gem in your hand, may I have it?

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满了，还想要更多。
lines.en: My beak is full and I still want more.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就叼着东西跑。
lines.en: One move from you and I run with my prize.

lines.zh: 我喜欢亮的东西，不讲道理。
lines.en: I like bright things; there is no reasoning with that.

lines.zh: 你把它放在地上，退三步。
lines.en: You set it on the ground and step back three paces.

lines.zh: 我一边吃一边看有没有更好的。
lines.en: I eat while checking for something better.

lines.zh: 铁锭我不想要，你拿着我就要。
lines.en: Iron does not appeal, but if you hold it, I want it.

lines.zh: 吃不完的，我藏进树洞里。
lines.en: What I cannot finish, I hide in a tree hollow.

lines.zh: 你手里的那枚戒指在响，我听见了。
lines.en: That ring in your hand rings. I hear it.

lines.zh: 金锭落地的那声，比叫我还清楚。
lines.en: A gold ingot landing is clearer than my name.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，嘴里的金子掉了。
lines.en: You bump me and the gold drops from my beak.

lines.zh: 我扑腾两下，飞到篱笆上。
lines.en: I flap twice and land on the fence.

lines.zh: 被挤到一边，我先看东西还在不在。
lines.en: Shoved aside, I check that my prize is still there.

lines.zh: 我落地时滚了一圈，羽毛乱了。
lines.en: I land and roll once, feathers in disarray.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我叫得很响。
lines.en: You step on my tail and I cry out loudly.

lines.zh: 我撞在木桩上，弹回来半步。
lines.en: I hit the post and bounce back half a step.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我在地上打转找。
lines.en: My prize falls and I spin around searching.

lines.zh: 我不生气，只是飞高一点。
lines.en: I am not angry; I simply fly a little higher.

lines.zh: 两只喜鹊撞在一起，各自散开。
lines.en: Two magpies collide and split apart.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太大，我绕着走。
lines.en: Your boots are too big; I walk around them.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的那颗金粒推给她。
lines.en: I push the brightest nugget toward her.

lines.zh: 两只一起叼草，巢就快好了。
lines.en: Two of us carry grass; the nest is nearly done.

lines.zh: 她叫一声，我就落到她旁边。
lines.en: She calls once, and I land beside her.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，尾巴朝同一个方向。
lines.en: We stand side by side, tails pointing the same way.

lines.zh: 我给她理颈后的毛，她不动。
lines.en: I tidy the feathers behind her neck; she holds still.

lines.zh: 巢里铺着亮片，是我的心意。
lines.en: The nest is lined with shiny bits; that is my affection.

lines.zh: 她不收铁，只收金子。
lines.en: She refuses iron and takes only gold.

lines.zh: 我们轮流孵，谁也不偷懒。
lines.en: We take turns brooding; neither slacks.

lines.zh: 雏鸟叫起来，像一群小铃铛。
lines.en: The chicks call like a handful of little bells.

lines.zh: 等它们会飞，我带它们去捡金子。
lines.en: When they can fly, I will show them where the gold is.

lines.zh: 地上有金粒，我叼起来就走。
lines.en: A gold nugget on the ground; I take it and go.

lines.zh: 这块宝石归我了，我先藏好。
lines.en: This gem is mine; I hide it first.

lines.zh: 我一次能叼三样东西。
lines.en: I can carry three things at once.

lines.zh: 你掉的锭，我替你保管。
lines.en: The ingot you dropped, I will keep safe for you.

lines.zh: 石头我不要，太沉又不好看。
lines.en: I do not want stone; heavy and dull.

lines.zh: 叼着东西飞不高，可还是要飞。
lines.en: With a prize I cannot fly high, but I still fly.

lines.zh: 树洞里已经存了一小堆。
lines.en: There is already a small hoard in the tree hollow.

lines.zh: 这颗金粒很小，可它亮。
lines.en: This nugget is tiny, but it shines.

lines.zh: 我一低头一抬头，东西就到嘴了。
lines.en: One dip of the head and the thing is in my beak.

lines.zh: 捡来的东西，打一下就会掉。
lines.en: Hit me once and all I gathered falls out.

lines.zh: 地上有东西在反光，我立刻盯住。
lines.en: Something glints on the ground; I lock on instantly.

lines.zh: 你手里的金子，比地上那堆更近。
lines.en: The gold in your hand is nearer than the pile.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，准备冲过去。
lines.en: I lower myself, ready to dash.

lines.zh: 有人把锭放在箱子上，我记下了。
lines.en: Someone left an ingot on the chest; I noted it.

lines.zh: 目标很小，可我不嫌弃。
lines.en: The target is small, but I am not picky.

lines.zh: 我绕到背后，那边风小。
lines.en: I go round the back, where the wind is weaker.

lines.zh: 那颗宝石落在草里，我也看得见。
lines.en: That gem fell in the grass; I can still see it.

lines.zh: 同伴先发现了，我跟着飞过去。
lines.en: A mate spotted it first; I fly after.

lines.zh: 我先叫一声，把别人吓开。
lines.en: I call once to scare the others off.

lines.zh: 定好了，就是那块亮石头。
lines.en: Settled: that bright stone.

lines.zh: 我贴地飞，翅膀几乎不响。
lines.en: I fly low, wings almost silent.

lines.zh: 你转身，我就停在你背后。
lines.en: You turn, and I stop behind you.

lines.zh: 我等那只乌鸦先走。
lines.en: I wait for that crow to leave first.

lines.zh: 风从左边来，我从右边接近。
lines.en: Wind from the left; I approach from the right.

lines.zh: 它一低头，我就往前挪一步。
lines.en: Each time it lowers its head, I take one step.

lines.zh: 亮东西在动，我更不敢眨眼。
lines.en: The shiny thing is moving; I dare not blink.

lines.zh: 人群散了，机会就来了。
lines.en: The crowd disperses, and my chance arrives.

lines.zh: 我停在最近的枝上，算好距离。
lines.en: I perch on the nearest branch and measure the distance.

lines.zh: 被看见也没关系，我跑得快。
lines.en: Being seen is fine; I run fast.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，等它转身。
lines.en: A little longer, until it turns.

lines.zh: 我啄它的手指，让它松口。
lines.en: I peck its fingers until it lets go.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇在它脸上，我趁机抓。
lines.en: My wings beat its face while I grab.

lines.zh: 我一爪抓走亮的东西。
lines.en: One swipe of my claw and the shiny thing is gone.

lines.zh: 它拍我，我翻了个身又回来。
lines.en: It swats me; I flip over and come back.

lines.zh: 我啄它的眼睛，只是吓唬。
lines.en: I peck at its eye, only to scare it.

lines.zh: 同伴也来了，它顾不过来。
lines.en: My mate joins in; it cannot watch us both.

lines.zh: 打完我嘴里还叼着东西。
lines.en: When it ends, I still have the prize in my beak.

lines.zh: 我力气不大，可啄得准。
lines.en: I am not strong, but I peck accurately.

lines.zh: 它一松手，我立刻飞走。
lines.en: The moment it loosens its grip, I fly.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，正好落在我脚下。
lines.en: What falls lands right at my feet.

lines.zh: 清晨我在树上醒来，先理羽毛。
lines.en: I wake in the tree at dawn and preen first.

lines.zh: 我落在这片田边，因为这里亮。
lines.en: I land at this field's edge because it is bright.

lines.zh: 黑白两色，在绿草里最好认。
lines.en: Black and white, easiest to spot in green grass.

lines.zh: 村里有谷子，也有掉下来的锭。
lines.en: The village has grain, and dropped ingots too.

lines.zh: 我绕着矿洞口飞了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the mine entrance once.

lines.zh: 树上已经有个空巢，我住下了。
lines.en: There is an empty nest in the tree; I move in.

lines.zh: 这地方没人赶鸟，很好。
lines.en: No one chases birds here; very good.

lines.zh: 我落脚时先看四周有没有猫。
lines.en: Before landing, I check for cats.

lines.zh: 翅膀还有点僵，我抖了两下。
lines.en: My wings are stiff; I shake them twice.

lines.zh: 今天能捡到什么，要看运气。
lines.en: What I find today depends on luck.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的羽毛缩成一团。
lines.en: Fire singes me and my feathers shrink into a ball.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下，半空才张开翅膀。
lines.en: I drop from the branch, wings opening halfway down.

lines.zh: 水一浸透，我就飞不动了。
lines.en: Once water soaks me, I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到半空，金子全撒了。
lines.en: The blast throws me up and all my gold scatters.

lines.zh: 箭擦过翅膀，我歪了一下。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my wing and I tilt.

lines.zh: 魔法的光贴上来，羽毛根根发麻。
lines.en: Magic light clings to me and every feather tingles.

lines.zh: 地上没有亮东西，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: Nothing bright on the ground; hunger makes me restless.

lines.zh: 雷落在坟头，我抓不住金粒了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the grave and I dropped my gold grain.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有枝，我找不到落点。
lines.en: No branches in the void; nowhere to land.
